verdict.rationale: SerpApi offers dedicated vertical endpoints. These include a Google News API with topic-token filtering (e.g. World, Business, Technology), a Google Flights API, a Google Ads API and a Google Ads Transparency Center API. Its client library also covers multiple engines such as Bing, Baidu, eBay and Home Depot. Missing for 10: no evidence of dedicated image or finance endpoints, and no independent or hands-on corroboration of vertical querying.
